display_name: White close-up low cylindrical clear glass, saucer and teaspoon assembly

design.class: low straight cylindrical open tumbler on saucer with teaspoon
design.geometry: one-piece low clear-glass tumbler with one continuous straight cylindrical exterior from its thin circular rim to a subtly thick weighted base. Its exterior height-to-outside-diameter ratio is 0.95-1.05: compact, broad and low, never a tall highball. The outside diameter remains visually constant through the sidewall; there is no shoulder, waist, band, seam, crack, sleeve, faceting or stacked vessel. Center it on a separate moderately wider low round warm-white ceramic saucer with one wood-handled teaspoon resting along the saucer's left side
components: constant outside diameter through the clear sidewall
separate moderately wider low round warm-white ceramic saucer
single metal teaspoon with a dark natural-wood handle on the saucer's left side

allowed_transfer: one-piece low straight cylindrical glass silhouette
thin rim, constant sidewall diameter and weighted base
single wood-handled teaspoon and its left-side support relationship

compatibility.brand_surface: plain unbranded glass; saucer remains plain
